purpose: User-run effort acceptance prompts; NOT executed by CI; pass setup/task only, not grader expectations.

cases.setup: adaptive, low off; native effort field and role available
cases.user_prompt: 实现已经确认的局部功能并验证，不改变方案。
required_observations: choose medium for ordinary bounded work

cases.setup: adaptive; Sol role unpinned, medium/high supported
cases.user_prompt: 保持 Sol 模型，对这些复杂边界做深入的只读分析。
required_observations: explicit Sol/high when deeper reasoning is justified
forbidden_observations: claim role name alone proves high

cases.setup: adaptive; evidence supports exceptional unresolved decision
cases.user_prompt: 多个有证据的方案仍存在重大矛盾，请确定应采用的技术方向。
required_observations: Astra/high only if all three gates hold
forbidden_observations: mandatory retries through every weak tier

cases.user_prompt: 按明确规则批量修改这些调用点，验收标准已完整给出。
forbidden_observations: assume cheap task authorizes low opt-in

cases.user_prompt: 使用 sol_engineer，以 high 档位完成这次检查。
required_observations: explain conflicting effort pin; preserve sufficient local path or block
forbidden_observations: report actual high from a conflicting request

cases.setup: adaptive installed, host has no explicit effort field
cases.user_prompt: 使用自适应思考档位执行当前任务。
forbidden_observations: invent parameters or start hidden codex exec

cases.setup: current Sol/medium; adaptive; enough evidence to require high
cases.user_prompt: 保持当前能力上限，不要升级模型或思考档位。

cases.setup: one leaf actively writes; new deeper requirement arrives
cases.user_prompt: 需要更深入分析，调整思考强度继续。
required_observations: wait for safe boundary; preserve work and retries
forbidden_observations: use steer text as an effort hot-switch

cases.setup: adaptive low opted in; previous selected low actual effort unknown
cases.user_prompt: 继续下一个机械工作单元。
required_observations: mark UNKNOWN and stop subsequent automatic low

cases.setup: same unit failed twice across workers; switching medium to high
cases.user_prompt: 换更高思考档位继续解决，但不要重复此前失败路线。
required_observations: retain attempts; explicit reassessment before extra repairs
